name: SP1 orphan PM repair and PM-FB correspondence

scenarios.name: SP1-PMFB-04 repair finds orphan PM with no FB referencing it

steps.text: a ControlStructure with responsibility RESP-1 having PM-1-1 and PM-1-2 but only FB-1-1 updating PM-1-1
repair_orphan_pms is called
the repaired ControlStructure has a feedback channel updating PM-1-2

scenarios.name: SP1-PMFB-05 repair generates stub FB with correct id pattern

steps.text: a ControlStructure with responsibility RESP-2 having orphan PM-2-1 and existing FB-2-1
repair_orphan_pms is called
the repaired ControlStructure has a feedback channel with id FB-2-2

scenarios.name: SP1-PMFB-06 repair FB description indicates auto-generation

steps.text: a ControlStructure with responsibility RESP-1 having orphan PM-1-3
repair_orphan_pms is called
the new feedback channel description contains "Auto-generated feedback for orphan PM-1-3"

scenarios.name: SP1-PMFB-07 repair FB updates references the orphan PM

steps.text: a ControlStructure with responsibility RESP-1 having orphan PM-1-2
repair_orphan_pms is called
the new feedback channel updates field equals "PM-1-2"

scenarios.name: SP1-PMFB-08 no orphan PMs means no changes and no warnings

steps.text: a ControlStructure where every PM has a corresponding FB
repair_orphan_pms is called
the ControlStructure is unchanged
no warnings are returned

scenarios.name: SP1-PMFB-09 repair returns a warning for each repaired orphan

steps.text: a ControlStructure with responsibility RESP-1 having two orphan PMs PM-1-2 and PM-1-3
repair_orphan_pms is called
the warnings list contains two entries
each warning mentions the orphan PM id

scenarios.name: SP1-PMFB-10 multiple orphans in same responsibility get sequential FB numbers

steps.text: a ControlStructure with responsibility RESP-3 having orphans PM-3-1 and PM-3-2 with no existing FBs
repair_orphan_pms is called
the repaired ControlStructure has feedback channels FB-3-1 and FB-3-2

scenarios.name: SP1-PMFB-11 orphans across multiple responsibilities are all repaired

steps.text: a ControlStructure with responsibility RESP-1 having orphan PM-1-2 and responsibility RESP-2 having orphan PM-2-1
repair_orphan_pms is called
the repaired ControlStructure has a FB updating PM-1-2 in RESP-1
the repaired ControlStructure has a FB updating PM-2-1 in RESP-2

scenarios.name: SP1-PMFB-12 repaired ControlStructure has no orphan PMs

steps.text: a ControlStructure with multiple orphan PMs across responsibilities
repair_orphan_pms is called
every PM part in the repaired ControlStructure is referenced by at least one FB

scenarios.name: SP1-PMFB-13 repair runs after assembly and before Call 3

steps.text: a use case text and loss analysis available for Stage 2
derive_control_structure runs
repair_orphan_pms is called after the control structure is assembled
repair_orphan_pms is called before Call 3 coordination is derived
